name: One Stop Food & Liquor
address: 1207 S. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Mold and dust accumulation was observed in varying amounts throughout the drink cooler. Owner noted the fans were cleaned ~1 month ago and may have contributed to some of the buildup. Spot check will be conducted in 10 days to verify cleaning.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed eggs and turkey bacon stored above the milk in the reach in cooler. Rearrange products to prevent from potential cross contamination.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels in the handsink in the bathroom. Provide paper towels.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed several boxes of chips, soda, and other items on the floor on the facility. Store all boxes at least 6 inches off the floor for protection.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1). Observed the seal to be broken of the cooler door #1 on the left side of the store. Repair the seal on the cooler door of #1 on the left side of the store. 2). Observed duct tape on the chest freezer behind the counter. Repair the chest freezer door.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1). Observed the shelves in the coolers around  the facility to be soiled with dust debris. Clean the shelves in the coolers. 2). Observed the door of cooler #5 to be sticky. Clean the door of cooler #5. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors in the walk-in cooler to be soiled with paper, juice, and debris. Clean the floors in the walk-in cooler.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Four packages of margarine were found in bottom of reach-in cooler with signs of water damage to packaging and margarine.  CORRECTED - all four packages were immediately, voluntarily, discarded.  No source of water could be found.  Make sure to protect food from damage.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the ice cream freezer next to front door has large amount of ice accumulation. Defrost freezer.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top around doors/tracks of ice cream freezers to be soiled. Clean these non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the following floors to be soiled: 1) floors were soiled in walk in cooler under shelving/along walls. 2) Floor soiled in storage room. Clean these floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 - Plastic coving on north side of front door was loose along the top. Seal the top of the coving to the wall with caulk or silicone to eliminate the gap.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Ice cream freezers by front door, freezers next to display cooler, and Home City bagged ice freezer all had heavy ice/frost accumulation. Defrost the aforementioned freezers. B) Ice cream storage freezer near display cooler had two spots on front of lid where insulation was exposed. Re-seal these openings. C) Trim was loose along the top inside the ice cream freezer at the front counter. Re-attach the loose trim.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e- The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) (R) top around doors/tracks of ice cream freezers; B) (R) tracks/bottom inside display cooler; C) bottom inside ice cream freezer next to front door; D) shelving in both walkin coolers; & E) general surfaces around reach-in section doors of cooler. Clean the above items and all general surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
**Maintain storage areas/counters with personal food items, microwave, coffee maker, and dishes clean to eliminate potential food sources for pests**

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d & 1120 - A) Restroom handsink and toilet were soiled. B) No paper towels were available at the restroom handsink. Clean the handsink and the toilet, and maintain supplies of soap and paper towels at the restroom handsink to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Front screen door had large gap along the bottom due to absence of a door sweep. Owner did not want to close the main door to the front entrance. Replace missing door sweep. Outer openings shall be tight fitting and vermin proof. **Check all outer doors and make necessary repairs**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Plastic coving on north side of front door was loose along the top, and a strip of coving was missing on the south side of the front door (behind 12pks of soda). Re-seal and replace coving on both sides of the front door. B) Restroom floor has a significant hole in one corner. Fill in the hole. When repairs are done the area needs to be smooth and easily cleanable. Do not use spray foam for repairs. C) Floors were soiled in walkin coolers under shelving/along walls. Clean the floors under shelving in walkin coolers.
